name: directional-drawer
title: Directional Drawer
description: A left-side slide-in panel with a small nav list and one call-to-action button at its base. Opening it dims the page behind, and the X or an outside click closes it.
use: Secondary navigation should open over the page without shifting the layout.
avoid: On desktop it cannot be dragged closed and the panel width is fixed at 450px.
a11y: The trigger is a plain div, so the drawer cannot be opened by keyboard; the X has no accessible name. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark panel fixed to the left of the frame, roughly 450px wide, with a white X at the top right, a bold heading, a line of grey helper text, four stacked nav links and a full-width light button pinned to the bottom.
behaves: Clicking Open Drawer slides the panel in from the left while the rest of the page dims and blurs; the X, a click outside or Escape slides it back out. On narrow screens a drag handle replaces the X.
customise: direction, outsideClose, open and setOpen are props; the heading, links and button are your own children.
weight: light: One slide-in panel with a backdrop blur; nothing loops.
